project_type: GPU benchmark infrastructure (bash scripts + python helpers) for DeepSeek-V4-Flash on B300/H200
build_system: No formal build system. Scripts are self-contained bash. Tests run via tests/run-tests.sh.
test_framework: Custom bash test framework in tests/run-tests.sh with stubs in tests/stubs/. Uses DRY_RUN=1 mode and stub PATH injection. Currently 15+ cases / 220+ assertions.
verification_instructions: 1) bash -n all modified scripts, 2) run tests/run-tests.sh and confirm all cases pass, 3) manual review of docker-compose YAML validity
setup_instructions: No setup needed - pure bash scripts with python3 for JSON manipulation. Stubs mock all external deps.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET mode. No GPU, no AWS credentials needed for Phase 0 (scripts + tests only). Docker not available in sandbox for compose validation but YAML structure can be validated.
contribution_requirements: From plan review doc: corrections must match proven values from S3 logs. SGLANG_OPT_DEEPGEMM_MEGA_MOE_NUM_MAX_TOKENS_PER_RANK=16384 (not 8320) for v0.5.17. Router --prefill must include bootstrap port. No --enable-dp-attention. Transfer backend must be nixl.
key_patterns: b300-run-config.sh: resolve_config() case statement sets CONFIG_DESC, CONFIG_ENV_ARGS, CONFIG_SERVE_ARGS, CONFIG_IMAGE. Single CONTAINER variable, single HEALTH_URL. poll-b300-h200.sh: SUBNET_MAP associative array, TARGETS array with 'type region az maxprice recipe' format.
directory_structure: scripts/ - main automation scripts and recipes/ subfolder. tests/ - run-tests.sh + stubs/ + fixtures/. docs/ - run summaries and operational docs. results/ - benchmark output. infra/ - lambda + deploy scripts.
